what: G2 reviewer compares Payhip favorably to WooCommerce and ThriveCart, stating Payhip fits in the middle between WooCommerce's complexity and ThriveCart's lack of a storefront.
verbatim_snippet: "Payhip makes it extremely easy to sell digital products and services online. I was fed up of trying other solutions. WooCommerce is a big headache, ThriveCart is limited to checkouts (no storefront), etc. And Payhip fits just in the middle."
